title: client_status
description: Report device status; any subset of the fields. Paired clients only. tvOS sends connection_type 'ethernet' every 300 s. The app version is not part of client_status: it comes with auth/pair; the hub ignores an app_version here. Limits: the hub removes control characters, cuts device_name to 100 and connection_type to 32 characters, and silently skips values of the wrong type, numbers outside their range and a current_area_id that is neither an existing area nor '__home__'. Battery: battery_level and battery_state are sent independently of the location rule (also by wall panels with location off), on every change and as a heartbeat every 300 s. panel: every app with a hub connection, also outside the wall panel mode – screen active while the app is in front, off when it leaves the foreground (sent at once if the system still lets it), panel_mode says whether the wall panel/kiosk is shown; null = no status (the screen entity shows off, the controls are unavailable). Apps never keep running in the background just to report.

low_power.description: Low power mode of the device (iOS/iPadOS, Android battery saver).

location_shared.description: What the app shares now; sent after auth_ok and on every change (system permission, rule). The position itself only travels with location_report.

panel.description: Device status for Home Assistant; any subset of the fields, the hub merges it into the last value.
